fusions.name: Caught on the Barb
fusions.desc: Casts a barb at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Raking Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes your claws through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 6-tile line of snags ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Nothing Gets Loose
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.
